The '''family''' of [[Tenebrae]] was originally a line of [[Sith (species)/Legends|pure-blooded Sith]],<ref name="Revan" /> which later became a [[Human/Legends|Human]] lineage when [[Valkorion]] became the host of Tenebrae,<ref name="Dream">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=2}}</ref> and had with the latter's body his three children: [[Arcann]], [[Thexan]], and [[Vaylin]].<ref name="Betrayed">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/star-wars-old-republic-–-knights-eternal-throne-–-‘betrayed’-trailer|text="Betrayed"|int=Betrayed}}</ref>
